ln:4462863150.descriptionHtml:
职位目标

  • 丰盛理财客户拓展主管协助丰盛理财客户拓展总监和支行行长对丰盛理财客户拓展团队进行领导和管理，通过新客户渠道开发管理和获取新合格丰盛理财客户增长，达成所分配的业务目标。
  • 建立和培训丰盛理财 客户拓展团队，为 银行的丰盛理财经理储备人才。

主要职责

  • 渠道开发和拓展合格丰盛理财客户
  • 领导和推动丰盛理财客户拓展经理共同开拓挖掘新客户获取渠道（如战略合作伙伴，客户推荐，行内活动等），为我行新增合格丰盛理财客户。
  • 维护和优化现有渠道质量，主动探索深化与渠道合作伙伴关系，在拓展新客工作中实现高效协同。
  • 指导和管控丰盛理财客户拓展经理对新客户开发的全流程进度，包括对潜在客户进行资质筛选和为新客户开立账户完成申请和相关文档。
  • 达成银行下达的各项销售任务，达到 售目标，为团队整体增长指标做出贡献。
  • 团队领导与发展
  • 招聘，培训和管理丰盛理财客户拓展团队，提供持续的指导与辅导，提升团队的销售产能和市场拓展技能。
  • 设定明确的销售策略，监控团队指标达成进度，以数据化驱动解决方案，对销售结果进行复盘分析，强化团队计划部署调整和执行。
  • 与员工保持明确和即时的沟通，提供激励和支持，督导并维持员工纪律。
  • 建立团队成员中的信任和士气，公平地处理员工问题。
  • 支行和跨部门协同合作
  • 协助支行管理和安排丰盛理财客户拓展团队与客户经理紧密合作，积极跟进新客户开发进度及确保客户交接顺畅和持续支持。
  • 与内部团队（如支行运营，风险，合规等）及外部合作伙伴跨部门协作，提升团队合作效率。
  • 客户关系管理
  • 领导丰盛理财客户拓展团队与对客户 务需求及时跟进，按照银行服务标准提供及时有效的解决方案，维持良好的客户满意度和留存率。
  • 主动处理客户疑虑，分析客户反馈，并及时改进服务交付质量。
  • 审计和合规控制
  • 遵守银行的政策、标准、操作准则/ 规程、安保及内部控制和合规措施，尤其是分支机构当地的操作规程。

遵守由当地监管机构做出的规则和规定，尤其是那些适用于销售过程的规则和规定。

职责管辖范畴

丰盛理财 客户拓展主管 向丰盛理财 客户拓展总监 汇报，并需负责达到和超越本团队所分配之各项销售指标。

教育背景和相关工作经验要求

教育经历

  • 拥有正规学历，商务或财务相关专业优先考虑
  • 对外资银行工作抱有热忱

工作经验

  • 至少 5 年相关工作经验。

具有管理领导下属的经验。

专业技能要求

  • 技术知识: 具备主动高效的客户沟通 巧，擅长通过专业化，场景化沟通话术
  • 产品知识:
  • 展现出对银行产品和服务的充分理解。
  • 对财务知识具有良好的理解。
  • 市场和行业知识: 一般行业中的市场趋势和竞争活动知识、了解当地和海外市场、理解个人银行业的竞争及对其产生的作用、影响和机遇
  • 人脉: 在组织内部和外部建立和维持人脉来促进业务增长。
  • 关注增长: 不断地寻找新的业务机会并以增长为导向，并将其融入到各种业务活动之中。

Location:

PRC - Shanghai

Job:

Product Sales

Schedule:

Regular

Employee Status:

Full time

ln:4461728313.descriptionHtml:
（Band:4/5）

Global Private Banking & Wealth

International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance. HSBC Private Banking helps high net worth and ultra-high net worth clients manage, grow, and preserve their wealth for generations to come. Our network of global experts helps clients access investment opportunities around the world, plan for future with wealth and succession planning, manage their portfolio with tailored solutions, and find the right support for their philanthropy.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

  • Establish new private banking relationships and manage existing relationships in order to grow Assets Under Management and Revenue
  • Monitor clients’ portfolios on a regular basis to identify additional business opportunities and revenue growth potential
  • Work closely with other HSBC departments, including International Wealth and P remier Banking, Corporate and Institution Banking and Global Banking and Markets, to identify cross-selling opportunities and bring all of HSBC’s relevant products and services to our clients
  • Leverage HSBC’s channels, network and brand to pursue business development activities with a focus on International Private Wealth clients
  • Ensure strict compliance with HSBC’s internal control standards, including areas of risk, regulatory compliance and financial crime compliance

To be successful in the role, you should meet the following requirements:

    • At least 10 years ’ relationship management experience, ideally in private banking, commercial banking or investment banking sectors
    • Proven track record in asset gathering, asset growth and revenue generation
    • Excellent communication and negotiation skills
    • Strong focus on client servicing
    • Excellent understanding of financial markets and wealth management products
    • Attention to detail and the ability to think creatively to solve problems
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within and inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Issued by HSBC Bank (China) Company Limited

ln:4461737146.descriptionHtml:
Some careers have more impact than others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of FINANCIAL SERVICES CLERK.

Principal responsibilities

  • Calculation and disbursement of management, advisory, administration, performance and custody fees;基金净值计算 （每日，每周或每月）；
  • Prepare financial statements and other financial related reports (as agreed) with the clients; 管理，咨询，资产服务，业绩和托管费用的计算和支付 ；
  • Clearing reconciliation breaks between Broker and our books of records;账目核对，检查并处理账目系统与银行流水中的缺失科目；
  • File records of correspondences and processed instructions for audit purposes;记录用于审计目的的客户指令的文件；
  • Accounting and accrual of fund expense;基金相关费用的会计分录及支付；
  • Delivery of accurate and timely report to Clients;客户定制报告服务。

Requirements

  • Undergraduate or graduate;在读大学本科或在读研究生；
  • Good knowledge of institutional funds and financial/investment related instruments / terms / fund services operations;熟悉金融工具或投资相关的产品和术语以及基金的运营服务；
  • Excellent communication skills in spoken and written English;英语听说读写流利；
  • Excellent team worker and Good interpersonal skill;良好的团队合作精神和人际交往能力；
  • Sound PC knowledge in Excel and MS Word; 熟练电脑操作（包括Word/Excel）；
  • High integrity and professionalism;高度的正直和专业精神；
  • Able to work under pressure and meet deadlines;能够承受一定的工作压力和在规定时间内完成日常工作；
  • Accept rotating shift; 接受早晚班的轮班制。

Candidate with less relevant experience or skills may be offered a lower Global Career Band than stated above.

Due to the urgent hiring need, candidates with immediate right to work locally and no relocation need will be prioritised.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

ln:4443817750.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

The successful candidate will be a skilled software engineer who is excited about working with a world class team to analysing, designing, developing and delivering solutions built for FM business.

We are looking for forward-thinking, energetic and passionate individuals to be part of a new exciting journey!

Key Responsibilities

  • Interact with both business and technical stakeholders to deliver high quality products and services that meet business requirements and expectations while applying the latest available tools and technology.
  • Design and review architecture for new software applications or enhancements to existing ones
  • Ensure that the architectural designs align with the company’s technological strategy and business goals
  • Present technical solutions, capabilities, considerations, and features in business terms. Effectively communicate status, issues, and risks in a precise and timely manner.
  • Hands on experience on AI development, eg Large Language Model / Deep Learning / NLP etc

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Skills And Experience

  • Big Data
  • JAVA
  • SQL/HIVE
  • SPARK
  • PYTHON
  • Communication
  • Problem solving
  • System Design
  • Excellent in communicating and presenting technology topics
  • Understanding of financial market and FX, Money Market, FX Options, Rates Derivatives, Commodities domain.
  • Apache Camel, Kafaka, Active MQ, Rabbit MQ , Rule Engine and so on
  • Practical experience on Microservice implementation.
  • Spring Framework stack – Spring Web MVC, Spring Batch, Spring Integration, Spring Boot, Spring cloud .
  • Practical experience on distribute system.
  • Performance engineering of Java applications
  • DevOps – Tools and Techniques
  • Product design skills & Marketing skills

Qualifications

  • Bachelor or Master Degree in Computer Science or Information Technology from a top tier university
  • More than 8 years of experience with Java/J2EE development experience
  • Project management relate experience.
  • Practical experience on Microservice implementation.
  • Practical experience on distribute system.
  • Strong analytical & problem solving and creative skills
  • Good communication skills in both written and oral English
  • Ability to be organised and multi-task on different requirements across various stakeholders, and to work independently and under pressure
  • Cultural sensitivity and awareness to work with a range of people from diverse background and geographies

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist.

Business:CTO Data Technology

Principal Responsibilities

  • Build and support Realtime Pipelines
  • Automate and maintain consistent development, test and production environments, including cloud infrastructure on the organisation’s chosen platform, such as AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud.

ln:4490564065.descriptionHtml:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Lead Business Analyst.

Business: Group DAO

Principal Responsibilities

The HK Reference Data Business Analyst role is required to deliver accurate, controlled migration of Customer Reference Data to support the delivery of CDMS HK. You’ll work with business and centralised migration execution teams to support migration activities end-to-end (analysis, mapping, cleansing, testing, reconciliation, cutover support), partnering closely with Technology, Operations, Data Owners, and Change teams to ensure data is complete, consistent, and fit for purpose. This is an individual contributor role (G5) with no people management responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities Include Some Of But Not Limited To

Migration analysis & planning

  • Analyse source-to-target data movements for customer reference/master data domains (e.g., customer identifiers, names, addresses, contact details, tax residency indicators, KYC-related reference attributes).
  • Produce and maintain migration deliverables such as data scope, mapping specifications, transformation rules, data lineage notes, and reconciliation approach.
  • Support estimation and sequencing of migration waves; identify dependencies, assumptions, and constraints early.

Data quality, profiling & remediation

  • Perform data profiling to identify duplicates, missing values, invalid formats, and policy breaches.
  • Define and execute cleansing/remediation steps with Data Owners and upstream teams; track issues to closure.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of data quality controls and repeatable migration playbooks.

Build support (requirements to engineering) & test execution

  • Translate business rules into clear requirements for ETL/configuration teams (or implement lightweight scripts where appropriate).
  • Create test scenarios and test data; execute SIT/UAT support activities focused on data outcomes.
  • Validate transformation logic through evidence-based checks (sampling + automated validations where possible).

Reconciliation, controls & cutover support

  • Run pre- and post-load reconciliations (record counts, key-field checks, exception reports, referential integrity checks).
  • Produce sign-off packs showing migration completeness, accuracy, and exceptions with clear risk statements.
  • Support dress rehearsals and cutover weekend activities, including defect triage and rollback considerations.

Governance, risk & documentation

  • Ensure migration activities meet HSBC control expectations (audit trail, approvals, evidence retention, change controls).
  • Escalate risks/issues promptly with options and impact assessment.
  • Maintain high-quality documentation that can be understood by stakeholders across Hong Kong and global teams.

Stakeholder collaboration

  • Work effectively with Technology, Data Governance, Operations, Compliance/Financial Crime teams, and programme change resources.
  • Communicate progress, blockers, and decisions clearly—especially when trade-offs arise (time vs. quality vs. scope).

Key stakeholders

  • Technology (data engineering/ETL, application teams, testers)
  • Data Owners/Data Stewards
  • Operations/Customer Services teams (where data is originated/maintained)
  • Change/Programme Management
  • Risk & Compliance/Financial Crime (where data impacts controls and screening outcomes)

Requirements

  • Proven experience (typically 3–6 years) as a business and data analyst or similar in a complex, regulated environment (financial services preferred), working with large datasets and multiple data sources.
  • SQL (or equivalent) capability for data extraction, reconciliation and data analysis tasks.
  • Solid understanding of data quality management (profiling, controls, issue root-cause analysis) and working knowledge of data governance concepts (lineage, metadata, critical data elements).
  • Experience translating business requirements into analytical outputs (KPIs, metrics definitions, reporting packs), including documenting requirements and assumptions.
  • Exposure to reference/master data concepts and operating model practices (e.g., data standards, domain ownership, stewardship) is desirable.
  • Familiarity with Agile ways of working (user stories, sprint ceremonies) and collaborating effectively across business, operations and technology teams.
  • Strong communication skills: able to explain complex data findings clearly, challenge constructively, and influence outcomes with evidence.
  • Degree (or equivalent experience) in a quantitative discipline (e.g., statistics, mathematics, computer science, economics) or demonstrable applied analytical capability.
  • Experience working with operational teams to understand, map and improve end-to-end processes (e.g., SIPOC/process mapping), identifying data pain points, control gaps and opportunities for simplification/automation.
  • Proven involvement in data migration activities (e.g., legacy-to-target mapping, data profiling, transformation rules, reconciliation and post-migration validation), supporting cutover readiness and hypercare where required.
  • Working knowledge of process change governance (impacts, risks, controls, training/adoption considerations) and how process changes affect upstream/downstream data flows and reporting.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role.

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

***Issued By HSBC Software Development (GuangDong) Limited***

ln:4491848018.descriptionHtml:
Job Summary

Turn market insights into meaningful client conversations. In this role, you will bring the Bank’s Chief Investment Office (CIO) and House View to life for frontline teams and clients, translating economic developments and financial market trends into clear, relevant commentary.

You will develop insights for client engagement, media exposure and seminars, while helping frontline teams connect macroeconomic themes with asset allocation discussions. Working with product teams, you will also support product solutions, contribute to the Bank’s brand visibility and manage relevant projects.

Key Responsibilities

  • Communicate the Bank’s views on key economic drivers, emerging trends and market movements to frontline teams and clients.
  • Develop clear, insightful content reflecting WRB’s views and the financial markets outlook for client communications, media exposure and seminars.
  • Help frontline teams interpret macroeconomic developments and apply these insights to asset allocation discussions.
  • Enhance SCB’s brand visibility by sharing relevant market commentary through authorised communication channels.
  • Provide economic and market insights to support the development of product solutions.
  • Coordinate and deliver projects supporting market commentary, communication of the House View and related initiatives.

Ideal Candidate

  • A Bachelor degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification or CFA designation would be an advantage.
  • 8-10 years of experience in investment strategy, equity research or portfolio management within a bank, asset manager or financial institution.
  • A strong understanding of global equity markets, company fundamentals, valuation methodologies, earnings trends and sector dynamics.
  • Solid experience in equity sector allocation, with the ability to assess economic cycles, sector valuations and earnings trends to inform sector positioning and rotation strategies.
  • Analytical capability assess economic developments, monetary policy and market data, translating findings into well-supported equity views and asset allocation insights.
  • Strong writing and presentation skills with fluent Cantonese, Mandarin and English and the ability to explain complex investment themes clearly to clients, frontline teams and other stakeholders. Experience delivering market briefings, seminars or media commentary would be an advantage.
  • A team player to work effectively with investment specialists, product teams and frontline colleagues, managing competing priorities and delivering timely commentary and projects.
  • A client-focused approach, strong attention to detail and an understanding of the regulatory and compliance standards governing investment communications.

About Standard Chartered

We're a global bank connecting clients to our differentiated network, offering growth opportunities in the world's most dynamic markets. Our strategy, which combines cross-border capabilities and leading wealth management expertise, helps us deliver our purpose - to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity.

Over our 170-year history, and across a unique geographical footprint connecting Asia, Africa and the Middle East to each other and the world, we've built a bank like no other, with diverse capabilities and partnerships that set us apart.

What We Offer

  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions, and geographies.
  • In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global employee assistance programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and self-help toolkits.
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual, and digital learning.

Visit our careers website to learn more about us: www.sc.com/careers.
